trello.name: Fix staging deploy registry token and restore deployment
trello.desc: Staging environment is broken: deploy job has been red since this morning and cannot pull the base image due to expired registry token. Ade rotated tokens yesterday and missed the CI token. Steps: 1. Regenerate the container registry token for CI use. 2. Update the corresponding CI secret/variable with the new token. 3. Re-run the staging deploy job. 4. Verify the job is green and the base image pulls successfully, confirming staging is testable again. Acceptance criteria: Deploy job passes, staging environment is deployable and accessible for testing. Owner: Ade. Target completion: within 1 hour from acknowledgement.

trello.name: Send updated Meridian proposal with new pricing to Lena
trello.desc: Meridian requested an updated proposal with new pricing, promised by end of day today. Pricing numbers are final in the spreadsheet. Steps: 1. Locate the final pricing spreadsheet and the proposal document. 2. Transfer the updated pricing numbers from the spreadsheet into the proposal doc. 3. Find Lena's email address from the Meridian kickoff thread; Lena is the procurement contact. 4. Send the completed proposal to Lena by end of day today. Acceptance criteria: Proposal document contains the final pricing from the spreadsheet and has been emailed to Lena, with confirmation of send. Owner: Ade.
